notes.title: January 12, 2024 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h3]January 15, 2024 Patch Notes[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Japanese translation review and retranslation
[*][b]BoardLand now supports Traditional Chinese![/b]
[*] Fixed some fonts and adjusted text placement
[*] Fixed Ryuka Generation-related bugs
[/olist]
The Japanese translation was reviewed and retranslated by kagerou01gata!
Thank you very much!

Traditional Chinese translation by Miumiu!
Thank you very much!

Thank you for following our cute little wizard's journey.

notes.title: January 12, 2024 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h3]January 12, 2024 Patch Notes[/h3]
[olist]
[*][b]BoardLand now supports the Japanese language![/b]
[*] Fixed a bug where level 3 tiles were targeted in the Roulette Tile Enhancement event
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented growth potions from being used on level 3 tiles
[*] Fixed a bug where the dice rewards panel would return to the original dice when closed and reopened after a reroll
[/olist]
Thank you for following our little and adorable wizard's journey.
